correctness.rationale: For distinct odd primes, the defining equation gives x=sigma(n)/(2n-sigma(n)); monotonicity forces 2<=x<=4, and the three values reduce respectively to (p-3)(q-3)=12, (p-2)(q-2)=6, and (3p-5)(3q-5)=40. Only the last has a prime solution, (3,5). For prime squares, p=3 is nonintegral and p>=5 gives 1<sigma(p^2)/(2p^2-sigma(p^2))<2. The package replays each step exactly.
